m2_rank2.why_sources: Pre-registered from LR-06's N-stable list before any M2 evaluation, without val data: isl_k targets the documented M1 failure axis (long-request sacrifice/segregation in the phase2-mid audits; M1 trails on AgentX's long contexts) and lets ISL enter only through the context (LR-06 action 2); mean_active_prefill_tokens_k is the set's prefill pressure, the router-observable analogue of A16.1's min_est_ttft_ms_s source for M2-ais, and has the largest within-cell spread of the load sources on the train tables (sd 1.10 vs mean 0.80; runs/phase2-ais/calib/m2ais_sources.json). The LR-15 drift check is INCONCLUSIVE and was not used (phase2_mid_fix lr15_drift).
m2_rank2.form: named-source LCL (LR-05): w = theta + sum_k c_k p_k; p_k0 pinned 0 (scale anchor, as M2-ais); theta7 pinned 0 and theta*_7 folded into p[isl_k][3] (feature 7 = isl_k x feature 3, an exact duplicate; LR-06, FEATURES.md)
m2_rank2.bounds: theta: M1 bounds; p: +-4 s_j / rms(source) (rms on the AIS-prep train theta0 tables; the same requests, isl_k is policy-independent, mean_active_prefill is the AIS-load default trajectory's: an approximation)
m2_rank2.sign_rule: theta3/4/5 clamped <= 0 (prereg) AND p_kj clamped <= 0 on load columns 3, 4, 5, 7 (both sources >= 0, so every effective load weight w_j stays <= 0 for every request): a tightening of the prereg's 'context term not sign-constrained', decided before any M2 evaluation, because p[isl_k][3] is exactly theta7's role and an unconstrained p would undo the A11.2 remedy (facts/DEVIATIONS.md)
m2_rank2.warm_start: theta*_M1 physical (clamped values 0 on theta3/4/7 start at the clamp edge, internal 0.5), p = 0, p std 0.3 x sigma0 = 0.0012 (LR-15); identical start for m1cont; at p = 0 M2 decides exactly as M1 (runs/phase2/checks/tierb_smoke: identical goodput on 2 cells)
